package_info.why_malicious: The affected versions of urllib3 contain a denial of service (DoS) vulnerability in the _encode_invalid_chars method in util/url.py. The method's inefficient handling of percent-encoded characters allows an attacker to craft URLs that cause the function to consume excessive CPU resources, resulting in a DoS condition. While not intentionally malicious, the vulnerability can be exploited for malicious purposes.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code processes URLs by collecting all percent-encoded substrings into an array without deduplication, then normalizes each encoding in a nested loop, resulting in O(n^2) CPU usage for specially crafted long URLs, leading to denial of service.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The method's quadratic time complexity for certain inputs allows attackers to exhaust CPU resources with a single crafted request, enabling denial of service.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal URL encoding should be efficient and not allow user input to cause excessive resource consumption. Here, user-controlled input can trigger expensive computation.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate URL encoding/decoding should handle percent-encoded characters, but should do so efficiently.
key_indicators: CPU exhaustion possible with crafted URLs

attack_chain.action: Attacker sends a specially crafted long URL with many percent-encoded substrings to an application using urllib3.
attack_chain.leads_to: The vulnerable _encode_invalid_chars method processes the input, consuming excessive CPU.

attack_chain.action: The application spends excessive time normalizing percent encodings, leading to resource exhaustion.
attack_chain.leads_to: Denial of service for legitimate users.

behavioral_signatures: Quadratic CPU usage in URL parsing functions
Excessive processing time for requests with long percent-encoded URLs
network_indicators: Inbound HTTP requests with unusually long or repetitive percent-encoded substrings in the URL
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor application logs and performance metrics for requests with long percent-encoded URLs that cause high CPU usage or slow response times. Review code for inefficient handling of percent-encoded characters in URL parsing functions, especially in urllib3 versions 1.25.2 through 1.25.7. Use dependency scanning tools to identify vulnerable urllib3 versions in your environment.
